image.title: Saint Lucy
image.creator: Francisco de Zurbarán
image.attribution: Francisco de Zurbarán, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: Zurbarán's Lucy holding her eyes on a dish, her traditional emblem

summary.en: Martyr of Syracuse who died in the persecution under Diocletian. Her name means light, and she was venerated above all as a protector of sight.

en: Associated with eyes and sight; her name comes from lux, light

media.title: St. Lucy
media.creator: J. Bridge
media.why: The legend of the Sicilian martyr whose name means light
